note: USACE Nashville District campground on a peninsula in Barren River Lake south of Glasgow, beside The Narrows marina and launch ramp. Loop A sits on wooded cliffs above the lake; Loop B is set back in open grass. Amphitheater, playground, horseshoe pit, the Lindsey Nature Trail, and a reservable picnic pavilion across the road. --Claude
summary: Kept. $34 flat (water + 50A), 89 public sites, max 111 ft (twelve B sites only 18-24 ft); season third Friday of May to mid-Sept (2027: 05-21..09-18); rec.gov, 14-night max. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (A loop is ~20 m up a wooded bluff; B loop 80 m+ from summer pool).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED: stored lakefront -> lakeview. Barren River Lake summer pool is 552 ft (~168.2 m). Loop A's east row (A05-A11, A13, A15, e.g. A08 36.904360,-86.067879 at 188.9 m; A15 36.905148,-86.068209 at 187.6 m) sits on a bluff: 3DEP drops 187-189 m to ~168 m in 15-20 m of horizontal distance, and Esri shows a continuous 30-45 m wooded band between the pads and the water - a view from the top of a cliff (rec.gov itself: 'a place uphill along the cliffs'). Loop B is on gentle grass but its nearest pads are far from summer pool: B17 (36.906076,-86.070876) reaches 168.2 m at ~85 m; B29 (36.905433,-86.072224) at ~80 m; B31 westward never drops below 172 m in 110 m. No site is within 50 m over open ground, and rec.gov tags no site Proximity to Water. The old note's 'Loop B sites let you pull a boat right up to the site' is not supported by imagery or terrain and has been dropped. Replacement evidence text: 'rec.gov catalog plotted on Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-23: A-loop east row ~20 m above the lake on a wooded bluff (A08 188.9 m vs summer pool 168.2 m, 30-45 m wooded band); B loop 80 m+ from summer pool -> lakeview'.

SITES: twelve B-loop sites are posted at 18-24 ft Max Vehicle Length (B01, B02, B03, B07, B09, B12, B15 at 18-19 ft; B24, B34, B53, B56, B57 at 21-24 ft); 77 others take 51-111 ft. Plenty of sites for a 23-ft rig.
